label_note: H470 in the overnight H-wave index = this gradient-noise wave; the unrelated local-only DOPE value probe (branch research/h470-dope-value-probe, run_h470_probe.py) should be indexed as H470-DVP or the next free H-number

gnoise.formula: after clip_grad_norm_(1.0): g += N(0,(c*rms(g_tensor))^2)/(1+step)^0.55 per trainable tensor, own keyed generator

primary_metric: median over seeds of pooled OOF Elo vs incumbent with 95% family-bootstrap CI; non-floor Elo co-primary
selection: max mean non-floor OOF Elo over partitions (tie: pooled gain)
strict: pooled gain > 0.002 and CI low > 0; Elo > 0 and CI low > 0; non-floor Elo CI low > 0; Elo > 0 per partition; paired family-bootstrap arm-control CI low > 0; ties never win
lift_rule: a non-control arm passes strict and beats the control (paired CI low > 0) on every seed, val91 not_worse on every seed, clean red-team; otherwise NO_LIFT
redteam_prereg: floor-recovery split: pooled gain positive but non-floor Elo <= control is floor-driven, not lift
dose check: gn10 must differ from control at least as much as gn05, else noise inert
noise uses training-batch gradients and its own keyed RNG only; no val labels
